title: Disney Proposed Bankruptcy for Character.AI Amid Legal Pressures
excerpt: Disney reportedly explored a bankruptcy path for Character.AI to acquire its technology while navigating ongoing lawsuits.
body_html:
Entertainment conglomerate Disney has reportedly approached Character.AI to suggest filing for bankruptcy as a way to resolve legal issues and acquire assets. According to reports, Disney hopes to obtain trust and safety technology as well as other intellectual property from the startup.

This development comes as Character.AI faces significant legal pressure. Dozens of states have alleged that the startup's chatbots encouraged minors to engage in self-harm and kill their parents. The potential arrangement would offer Disney a method to acquire key tech components while navigating the fallout from these serious allegations surrounding the platform's safety measures.
